issues.description: The getter method for the StockIngredient 'name' field uses different identifiers across repositories: the template defines getIngredientName(), while the solution defines getName(). Corresponding usages in Stock.findStockIngredient() also call these different getter names. The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not specify the expected getter name. This naming mismatch across template and solution can confuse students (and test authors) about the expected getter name and lead to inconsistent references when comparing implementations or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getter name for the StockIngredient 'name' field across repositories and references. For example, rename getIngredientName() to getName() in the template (and update any calls in Stock.findStockIngredient()), or update the solution to use getIngredientName() everywhere. Also clarify in the problem statement that getters should follow the conventional naming (e.g., getName, getPrice, getQuantity) to avoid ambiguity.
